title: Day 1 of adding YOUR ideas to my territorial strategy game.
author: Feisty_Yesterday3807
selftext:
So basically, I’m making a territory-based strategy game where the goal is to expand your land, conquer other players, and eventually dominate the map.

It’s kinda inspired by Territorial.io, but I want to push the concept way further, make it more strategic, more chaotic, more fun, and honestly, closer to how people always imagine these types of games should be.

And the best part: you guys are gonna help shape the game.

Drop your ideas in the comments, and I might actually add them.

Oh yeah… the entire game was vibe-coded.

And this video was too.
